## Summary
Implement ECD Stages 1-3 as the first pipeline step: derive ProficiencyVariables from the faculty spec, generate evidence rules that map observable behavior to proficiency, and select the appropriate TaskShell from the seeded catalogue.

## User story
As a pipeline engineer, I want the ECD stages to transform a faculty spec into a structured generation blueprint, so that downstream steps generate items that validly measure the intended competencies.

## Why this matters
ECD is the theoretical foundation for valid assessment. Without proper ProficiencyVariable derivation, items may test the wrong thing. Without correct TaskShell selection, item format won't match the cognitive level. Invalid items waste faculty review time and erode trust.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Stage 1: Derives ProficiencyVariables from spec's SubConcept + SLO + Bloom level targets
- [ ] Stage 2: Generates evidence rules mapping observable student behavior to each ProficiencyVariable
- [ ] Stage 3: Selects TaskShell from seeded catalogue (12 shells from E01-S07) based on Bloom level + evidence rules
- [ ] Output shape: `{ proficiencyVars: ProficiencyVariable[], evidenceRules: EvidenceRule[], taskShell: TaskShell }`
- [ ] Three-hub validation: confirms SubConcept + SLO + USMLE_Subtopic all present before proceeding
- [ ] Items missing any hub edge are flagged `incomplete` and blocked (D06 three-hub invariant)
- [ ] Queries Neo4j for SubConcept/SLO/USMLE_Subtopic connections using neo4jQuery
- [ ] All Claude responses parsed with safeJsonParse (Rule 2)
- [ ] Model: HAIKU_MODEL for ECD derivation (cost-efficient, non-core step)

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 1 (C05) | neo4jQuery for all Neo4j reads (SubConcept, SLO, USMLE_Subtopic lookups) |
| Rule 2 (H06) | safeJsonParse for Claude response parsing in ProficiencyVariable derivation |
| Rule 4 (D05) | HAIKU_MODEL for ECD stages (non-core generation step) |
| Rule 5 (H12) | sanitizeForContext for any spec content passed to Claude |
| D06 | Three-hub invariant: validate SubConcept + SLO + USMLE_Subtopic connectivity |

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// apps/inngest/functions/p3-steps/ecd-stages.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client';
import { safeJsonParse } from '@journey/ai/safe-parse';
import { HAIKU_MODEL } from '@journey/ai/constants';
import { sanitizeForContext, buildContextBlock } from '@journey/ai/sanitize';
import { loadPrompt } from '@journey/ai/prompts';

interface ECDOutput {
  proficiencyVars: ProficiencyVariable[];
  evidenceRules: EvidenceRule[];
  taskShell: TaskShell;
}

export async function ecdStages(specData: SpecData): Promise<ECDOutput> {
  // Stage 1: Derive ProficiencyVariables
  const subconcepts = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (sc:SubConcept) WHERE sc.uuid IN $ids RETURN sc',
    { ids: specData.subconcept_ids }
  );

  // Stage 2: Generate evidence rules via Haiku
  const sanitizedContext = sanitizeForContext(JSON.stringify(subconcepts));
  const contextBlock = buildContextBlock('subconcept_data', sanitizedContext);
  // ... Claude call with HAIKU_MODEL

  // Stage 3: Select TaskShell
  const taskShell = await selectTaskShell(specData.bloom_level, evidenceRules);

  return { proficiencyVars, evidenceRules, taskShell };
}
```
